context.rollback: Before integration: do not merge - the feature exists only on the branch. After integration: revert the merge commit (git revert -m 1); the change is additive. After shipping: user revokes translation consent (stops cloud text send, keeps offline mode); or unregister the plugin (one registration in AppCoordinator.swift) which makes the feature unreachable via an explicit tested 'unavailable' path; or lower the shared Gemini per-day budget (floor 10, shared with voice); or remove the API key (blunt, stops all Gemini use). No remote kill switch exists (the encrypted remote-configuration channel is a recorded descope).
